summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the \x1b]0;{title}\x07 format entry and a documented Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, writing the control only when is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy branch calling term.set_title with the control's second item; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: the test suite, Black formatting, and the Windows renderer test, which only runs on Windows. Next step is to run pytest on the three test files and black --check.
